Replace Sona's remark 'Merc jisme se ang ubhar aayce hai' with 'Bahut Garmihai' while talking to Ratan suggestively.
Reduce the shots where Ratan is seen patting her bare back and the girl feeling passionate.
Delete the portions of the scene where Ratan is trying to kiss Kammo and taking his lips too close to his and also his leg coming over Kammo's legs.
Reduce the views of Ratan being dragged by a jeep and also reduce the fight between Ratan and scordas where there are hard hitting shots.
Reduce the fight between Ratan and Master avoiding hard hitting shots.

Reduce the fight between Ratan and Master on the terrace of a building under construction particularly the shots showing the villain being pulled by means of a rope and his hard dashing against the wall.
Reduce the impact of violence in the trailer.
Reduce dragging of the hero behind running motor-cycles.
Delete the front view of the man buttoning up his pant while running, after urinating, when his scooter is taken away by Bhola.
Reduce the fight with a view to reduce the gruesome impact and tension and delete the close shot of blood smeared face of a man after the tiger's attack.
